recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core edit is needed unless a future decision changes Patient.link or the Patient/RelatedPerson boundary.
issue_request: Applied/Persuasive with Modification PA request to clarify that a person represented as a RelatedPerson can also be a Patient in their own right, but is not the primary target of the healthcare context represented by the RelatedPerson resource.
initial_application: Git commit 4797eb31dfa11eaf9eafb92648ef80fd29649e87 added the Patient.link boundary paragraph and updated the RelatedPerson description to primary target. Git commit ac19f96ea99363caf67b40b42f035d7ee1ddf553 applied the same wording to the root element definition.
additional_context: FHIR-41566 removed the formal-responsibility clause from the same sentence, so current source intentionally omits that clause while preserving FHIR-41559's primary-target clarification. The July 2023 PA minutes record FHIR-41559 as persuasive with modification 3-0-0.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because both requested source surfaces are already correct after accounting for FHIR-41566.
